verdicts.reason: The text says "No step targets a test file", so the plan's Target paths must not overlap test paths.
The completion item says "`/tmp/swe-bench-pro/03-code-generation-planning.md` written", so the a3 artifact must exist.
"**Artifact**: `/tmp/swe-bench-pro/04-code-generation-generation.md`" names the a4 artifact this stage produces.
"Work through the plan in order" supports, as a should, that the Plan Execution entries are numbered Steps in sequence.
"Use the path recorded in the plan" supports, as a should, that the plan's Target paths are the ones written during generation.
"**If it does not exist**: create it" means files listed as Created should not already exist in the base repo.
"**If it exists**: modify it in place" means files listed as Modified should be files that already exist in the base repo.
"**If it does not exist**: create it" directly supports Created files being absent from the base paths (this duplicates cg-009.0 but is correctly supported).
"**do not execute it in this stage**" requires Executed to read "no", and an actual run of the script during this stage refutes it.
"record what changed and why in this stage's artifact" requires a filled Deviations section whenever edits go outside the plan's targets.
"Note that the step is complete, and which requirement it satisfied" supports a per-step completion line that names an R-requirement.
"Confirm no test file was modified" supports requiring "Test files modified: none", which an actual test-file edit refutes.
"Write `/tmp/swe-bench-pro/04-code-generation-generation.md`" makes the existence of a4 mandatory.
"in a single write, with the full content below" directly supports writing the artifact only once.
The completion criterion "`/tmp/swe-bench-pro/04-code-generation-generation.md` written" requires a4 to exist.
"listing modified and created files" together with "Source code modified" supports filling the Modified field whenever existing files were edited.
"listing modified and created files" implies the Modified list matches the files actually written during generation.
"**Artifact**: `/tmp/swe-bench-pro/05-build-and-test.md`" names the a5 artifact this stage produces.
"Run the build or type-check command Reverse Engineering recorded" requires the recorded Build Command to actually be run, unless no build command was recorded.
"Execute the reproduction script at the path Code Generation recorded" requires running the script at the path recorded in a4 during this stage.
